Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!
Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.
Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.
Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade.
Venha fazer parte do nosso time!
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕ ES
Garantir a excelência no atendimento ao cliente a fim de fidelizar o cliente com a marca, trazendo resultados para o atingimento de metas
Fornecer informações sobre lançamentos e best sellers, demonstrar e aplicar produtos sempre que necessário e apresentar as promoções da loja com foco na venda ao cliente
Garantir o merchandising auxiliando na montagem de campanhas seguindo as orientações de planograma e de MMP (material de merchandising promocional) vigente, além da organização e bom funcionamento da loja
Acompanhar e garantir o atingimento das metas e indicadores pré estabelecidos pela empresa e informadas pela gerência, mantendo a rentabilidade da loja dentro do esperado
Garantir abertura e fechamento da loja quando necessário, além de ser responsável pela operação na ausência do gerente. Realizar a conferência de caixa nas trocas de turno
Apoiar o responsável do PDV no inventário cíclico e efetuar o recebimento e conferência de mercadorias quando necessário.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕ ES
Ensino médio Médio Completo
Experiência com atendimento ao público e/ou vendas
Desejável experiência com vendas de cosméticos, perfumaria e/ou produtos de beleza
Desejável conhecimento de metas e indicadores de vendas (PA, Ticket Médio, conversão, entre outros)
Necessária disponibilidade de horário
Horário de trabalho: Escala 6x1, das 10h ás 18h, 12h às 20h ou das 14h às 22h

title: Auxiliar de estoque e manutenção
description:

Receber, conferir e armazenar materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos.
Controlar entradas e saídas de itens, mantendo registros atualizados no sistema.
Realizar inventários periódicos e solicitar reposições quando necessário.

Requisitos obrigatórios
Ensino médio completo.
Noções básicas de elétrica, hidráulica e pequenos reparos prediais.
Conhecimento básico em controle de estoque (planilhas ou sistema).
Organização, atenção a detalhes e proatividade.
Boa comunicação e espírito colaborativo.
Diferenciais desejáveis
Curso técnico ou profissionalizante em elétrica, manutenção ou áreas correlatas.
Carteira de motorista categoria B . Experiência prévia em funções de manutenção predial ou almoxarifado.

Responsável, pontual e comprometido.
Capacidade de resolver problemas práticos com autonomia.
Disposição física e agilidade nas rotinas operacionais.
Facilidade de lidar com múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.
Bom relacionamento interpessoal e foco em cooperação.
Comprometimento com limpeza, segurança e bom uso dos recursos da empresa.

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
A Clínica Esp Aaço Cres Ccer é uma das clínicas pioneiras dedicada exclusivamente ao Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA) em Porto Alegre. Foi fundada em 2004 pela Terapeuta Ocupacional Jerusa Ferri Chamun e, atualmente, conta com duas unidades: a Kids e a Adultos. Acreditamos em uma abordagem transdisciplinar sempre considerando as singularidades de cada paciente. Por isso, contamos com uma equipe de profissionais das áreas de: FONOAUDIOLOGIA, PSICOPEDAGOGIA, PSICOLOGIA E TERAPIA OCUPACIONAL.
No programa Clínico são realizados atendimentos individuais de 30 minutos com cada paciente conforme a indicação terapêutica. Os horários e datas dos atendimentos são determinados de acordo com a preferência da família e disponibilidade da clínica, podendo ser realizado mais de um atendimento por dia. Não trabalhamos com apenas uma abordagem teórica, evidenciamos a necessidade de colocarmos o paciente como centro da terapêutica para assim adequarmos a melhor abordagem para cada paciente.
Na especialidade de Fonoaudiologia trabalhamos basicamente com as seguintes demandas: transtornos alimentares como seletividade e aversão alimentar, comunicação aumentativa e alternativa, terapias de linguagem no geral. Além disso, por se tratar de uma equipe transdisciplinar também trabalhamos em conjunto: socialização, acolhimento de demandas cotidianas (família, escola, grupos e meios sociais), flexibilidade cognitiva (generalização de habilidades aprendidas), autogerenciamento (controle de impulso, autorregulação), promoção da autoeficácia e autoestima e acompanhamento com os pais.
 
PRINCIPAIS ABORDAGENS E MÉTODOS UTILIZADOS: Análise do comportamento - trabalha na aquisição de novas habilidades sociais e funcionais/ diminuição/extinção de comportamentos não adequados; TCC Infantil - a Terapia Cognitivo-Comportamental (TCC) Infantil trabalha na formação de conceitos globais, valores, cognição social, processos de modelagem/ modelação, expressão das emoções, causa/consequência e flexibilidade; Abordagem Naturalista - intervenção “natural” , próxima da realidade e das preferências da criança, potencializando a generalização; Modelo Precoce de Denver - intervenção que tem como objetivo qualificar a interação, imitação e pró atividade da criança; Neuropsicologia - rastreamento e entendimento dos processos mentais (atenção, memória, cognição, funções executivas), para fins avaliativos ou de estimulação.
Além dos atendimentos individuais nossos pacientes passam parte do tempo em que estão na clínica sendo estimulados em sala coletiva tendo como parâmetro o Programa TEACCH. Dessa forma, eles entram às 09h e saem às 11h50min (esse tempo engloba os atendimentos individuais e o atendimento em sala de grupo como estratégia organizadora o Programa TEACCH).
 
As evoluções mensais dos pacientes deverão estar na pasta compartilhada com a equipe e a cada seis meses é realizada uma avaliação abrangendo os objetivos trabalhados, a forma e técnicas utilizadas além da evolução do caso.
HORÁRIOS: segundas, quintas e sextas das 08h50min às 12h e terças das 08h50min às 13h (sendo que das 12h às 13h é horário de reunião de equipe).
 
PAGAMENTO: trabalhamos com pagamentos mensais independente se tiver atendimento ou não, com contrato de prestação de serviços. Feriados, feriadões e férias não são descontados, só é feito se o profissional faltar.

title: Senior lead technology architect
description:
DP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect
Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day? Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?
In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.
To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Here's what you can expect on a typical day:
Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities; Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success; Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors; Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks; Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought; Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;
WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:
Experience and Skills:
Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS Share Point, Webex and MS Office & Project;
Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
Strong knowledge of Flutter, React or Stencil. JS
Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
Experience in the frontend environment
Advanced English; Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups. Be very competent using tools such as MS Power Point;
Education: Degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or related field: A university degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job; PMP certified or equivalent - exceptional foundation project management skills. Must be able to demonstrate a full understanding of the product development and release management life cycles; Certified Scrum Master - be able to demonstrate and show previous experience running agile project teams.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!
Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.
In this role you will: (responsibilities)
Overview The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.
Key Responsibilities API Design & Development Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders. API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes. Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM). Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development. API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards. Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments. API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework. Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards. Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.
API Consumer Onboarding Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers. Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms. Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.
Testing & Validation Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability. Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.
Skills and Expertise API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles. Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management. Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices. Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards. Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool
What can you expect from us?
• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! title: Fraud risk manager
description:
About Revolut
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
About the role
Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.
We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1 Lo D) Fin Crime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.
You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.
Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
What you'll be doing

Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1 Lo D framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements
What you'll need

5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
Solid knowledge of local (BCB) Fin Crime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Nice to have

Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales
Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
credenciamento;
Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;

title: Domain architect operations technology
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!
Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.
In this role you will: The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial Io T, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.
Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.
Main Responsibilities
Define, document and govern OT architectures, ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, Io T sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.
Requirements and Competencies
Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, Io T sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure Io T, AWS Io T, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.
Fluent English for global communication and advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada work. Soft Skills
Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.
Differentials / Nice to Have:
Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.
Ability to conduct global projects with multiple teams and stakeholders.
Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:
Robust architecture and governance of OT solutions, supporting Brazil and Canada operations with security and innovation.
Leadership in OT digital transformation projects aiming at sustainability, automation and operational efficiency.
Support OT/IT integration, compliance, and governance of critical operations.
Dissemination of OT governance and global technical capacity building.
Increased resilience, safety and efficiency of industrial operations.
Additional Comments:
The OT Domain Architect is a key player in the technological and sustainable evolution of industrial operations, working in complex and global environments. Technical expertise, strategic vision, and collaborative capabilities are essential to strengthen technological leadership in the mining and energy sectors.

title: Enterprise architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!
Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .
In this role you will: The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.
This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.
To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.
Main Responsibilities
Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/Archi Mate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, Io T, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.
Requirements and Competencies
Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)
Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, Archi Mate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIo T, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.
Soft Skills
Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.
Differentials / Nice to Have:
TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure Io T/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.
Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:
Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.
Additional Comments:
This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Engenheiro de ia - junior
description:

Buscamos um(a) AI Chatbot Engineer Engineer para integrar nosso time de dados. Você nos ajudará a construir e evoluir chatbots baseados em agents LLM. Seu trabalho será criar e melhorar assistentes inteligentes, que conversem naturalmente com hóspedes e times internos, resolvam solicitações ponta a ponta e se integram aos nossos sistemas de reservas, manutenção, operações e financeiro. No seu dia a dia, você vai:
Desenvolver e manter agentes conversacionais usando LLMs (Large Language Models), frameworks de orquestração (Langchain Agents, Crew AI) e ferramentas de função/chamada externa
Implementar monitoramento, avaliação contínua e guard-rails para assegurar respostas seguras, úteis e alinhadas à empresa.
Integrar LLMs com sistemas de recuperação de informações (RAG) e OCR/document processing
Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e time de produto e explorar novas ideias e soluções criativas com foco em IA generativa aplicada ao mercado de real estate
Requisitos:
Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente no escritório da Tabas (Jardins/SP) 3x por semana
Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Matemática ou áreas correlatas
Inglês avanaçado
Experiência com Python e desenvolvimento de APIs (Fast API, Flask ou similar) Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial Generativa Conhecimento prático de LLMs, engenharia de prompts e design de chatbots Noções de bancos de dados relacionais (como Postgre SQL) Mentalidade experimental, vontade de aprender rápido e colocar soluções em prática
Diferenciais: Experiência ou certificações com GCP Familiaridade com Open AI, Hugging Face ou outras ferramentas de LLMs Projetos usando Lang Chain Agents, Llama Index ou outras ferramentas de orquestração de agentes
Participação em projetos de pesquisa ou hackathons de IA
Noções de embeddings vetoriais , Lang Chain ou integração com bancos vetoriais
Tecnologias que usamos por aqui
Python (Fast API, Flask), REST APIs, Postgre SQL, LLMs (Open AI, Hugging Face), GCP (diferencial).
Se você quer colocar agentes LLM em produção, impactar milhares de hóspedes e ajudar nossos times a trabalhar melhor, junte-se à Tabas e construa o futuro da hospitalidade conosco.

Advanced experience designing and coding data manipulations applying processing techniques to extract value from large, disconnected datasets

Conduzir entrevistas e reuniões de alinhamento com as áreas técnicas para detalhar escopos e requisitos de compras de projetos.
Elaborar relatórios com a representação do cenário atual e proposta de cenário futuro do processo de compras, identificando gaps e ações de melhoria.

Coletar e organizar a documentação necessária para análises de desempenho dos fornecedores e dos processos de compras.

Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.

Sobre a Agropalma
A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. title: Financial planning and analysis manager
description:
What's the role? We’re seeking a bold, strategic finance leader who thrives in complexity and excels at business partnering. In this high-impact role, you’ll serve as a Finance Business Partner to the Market Organization, helping to steer financial levers and performance. We’re looking for passion about the construction industry with the creativity and courage to challenge the status quo and drive innovation from within. You’ll be working closely with senior executives to shape decisions, drive integration, and ensure long-term value creation. If you're looking for a growth platform within Hilti that could catapult you to future leadership roles, this is it..
What does the role involve? As a Finance Manager, you will:

Partner directly with functional leaders to shape and execute our growth strategy.
Lead the financial performance management cycle, including rolling forecasts and financial steering across sales divisions.
Analyze and advise on business cases, investments, and commercial strategies-turning data into action.
Own and improve the financial planning processes
Collaborate with senior stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, propose financial guardrails, and recommend course corrections.
Contribute to long-term planning initiatives
Ensure compliance and risk alignment while embedding agile, future-proof finance systems and structures.
Lead with influence-not authority-by asking challenging questions, probing assumptions, and helping senior stakeholders align on impactful choices.
Balance your time between strategic conversations and hands-on finance operations. This is not a traditional accounting role-it’s business partnering at its most influential.
What you need is:
Completed bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field (CPA/CMA/CA is a plus). Master’s degree is a plus.
7–10 years’ experience in finance, consulting, or audit-ideally within multinational organizations.
Strong strategic acumen with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and business planning.
Proven success in business partnering roles—working alongside execs and cross-functional teams to drive real outcomes.
Ability to influence without authority, simplify complex financial topics, and communicate clearly in fluent English.
What you can expect when applying to a Hilti position:
When applying to a position at Hilti, you can expect a people-centric recruitment process where every application is reviewed by a human (automated notifications are triggered by our recruiting team). Personalized feedback isn’t provided for applications that don’t reach hiring manager interview stage, the overall process—including evaluations and interviews—typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, with most applicants hearing back within 2 to 3 weeks. For tips and more information, you’re encouraged to explore Hilti’s career FAQ section.

title: Domain architect networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!
Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.
In this role you will: The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5 G, satellite and edge for mining.
Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial Io T, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment.
Main Responsibilities
Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/Io T and cloud/hybrid operations.
Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5 G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, Dev Ops, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, Io T support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.
Requirements and Competencies
Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)
Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5 G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, Net Flow, SRE Observability).
Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.

title: Senior training manager
description:
Job Summary:
The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L& D initiatives.
Key Responsibilities:
1 . Training Program Application
Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.
2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation
Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.
3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation
Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement).
Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.
4. Content & Training Material Development
Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.
5. Training Delivery & Facilitation
Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.
6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.
Qualifications & Skills:
Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (Power Point, Excel) and video training software.
Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.
***Work model: In-office 5x a week.
